negative_snippets:
Worst hotel I have stayed in till now.
They are charging way too much for the kind of service they provide. The room condition was poor and unhygienic — torn and smelly bedsheets, furniture in bad shape, the TV was just for show, and the bathroom latch didn’t even work.
The room has a shared window with the neighboring room, and although it’s closed, everything from the other room is clearly audible. On top of that, the reception staff create noise right outside the rooms, showing no consideration for guests.
I would never recommend this hotel to anyone, it's not safe or decent especially for a couple.

Booked this premises on line via Booking. Com. Worst experience from online booking and worsted hotel. It's not even third grade. Smelly rooms, improper bathroom, no amenities and paid as good as 5 star hotel.
